expanders.function: bank A and B GPIO isolation

flexypin_revision.courtyard: On-board digital module body; the original RF keepout separately protects the overhanging antenna

reset_interlock.software_reset_requirement: GPIO0 must return to input with pull-up; never enable GPIO hold on GPIO0; qualify software/watchdog/brownout behaviour on prototype
reset_interlock.datasheet_limit: Logical interlock unchanged. Nyfea reset/POR/brownout limits remain to be qualified on prototype.
reset_interlock.also_enables: U63 EN follows EXP_RESET_N with R301100k pulldown; shared reset/row-power enable

power_entry.module_holes: 1.1 mm finished plated holes; 2.54 mm pitch; centres 3.1 mm inward from original contacts
power_entry.usb_feed: VBUS -> D6 SS54 anode -> cathode -> 5V rail
power_entry.module_requirement: Regulated 5V output with reverse-current blocking; CAN presence/termination pin must follow the chain interface

usb_vbus_sense.firmware: Configure GPIO14 as input only (no internal pulls). Read VBUS directly, including before MCP arming, and attach/detach USB as appropriate. Qualify ROM/bootloader and host-off behaviour.

connector_revision.note: SMD contacts, nonplated PCB entry holes; bottom mating needs physical qualification

display.status: Removed for hand-assembled commercial revision; archived in backup

core_optimization.retained_safety: 48gate/OE bias resistors,3FCA9539,reset interlock,RGB bypass and regulator parts

schematic_revision.style: Functional dashed zones, explicit wiring, documented global nets only

pages.title: 04 - Controllo righe, reset sicuro e Qwiic

schematic_revision.electrical_changes: Dual P/N device split into independent single MOSFETs with equivalent connections
schematic_revision.last_change: Independent internal GPIO4/5 and user GPIO11/12 I2C buses, each with its own4.7k pull-ups

direct_headers_removed.note: All other GPIO/row assignments unchanged; pins remain accessible through FlexyPin

side_ports_revision.usb_side: left in breadboard view, facing left

row_indicator_silkscreen.row_connections: Rounded row capsules, same-net links, matching RGB halos and short leaders

area_measurement.area_method: sum of native footprint bounding boxes excluding reference/value; placement/routing space not guaranteed

compact_rgb16_revision.usb_side: left in breadboard view, facing left

passive_mezzanine.role: passive direct access, no new switching/protection
passive_mezzanine.mating_height_mm: TBD; elevated daughterboard required to clear existing components

mechanical.contact_numbering: pin1 square; odd/even pairs follow native KiCad socket footprint
mechanical.daughterboard_height: to clear existing Hanxia, power and USB bodies; not validated; do not use generic low stacking height
mechanical.positions_F_face: both below breadboard, toward south; daughterboard may extend north with suitable height

row_power_protection.protected_mode: 3V3 source to GND short;16P sources and PG pullups downstream
row_power_protection.retry: automatic thermal retry, no fault output

magnetic_expansion.side: F.Cu electronics face, opposite the RGB/breadboard visible face
magnetic_expansion.shared_holes: 1..5 drilled by J9/J2; Hanxia footprint omits duplicate NPTH; pads connect to same net

label_indicators.word_openings: B.Mask horizontal text; F.Mask aperture rotated45; all4copper layers excluded
label_indicators.optical_and_assembly_validation: Required. FR4 transmission and raised/reverse assembly must be tested; window design is not optically qualified.
label_indicators.firmware: Not implemented. Clear all frame enables/PWM while in software shutdown, then enable only active mode. GPIO14 freed but not added to connectors.
label_indicators.LED_model: genericKiCad1206castellated, rotated; not manufacturer exact model
label_indicators.qualification: Values are calculations; PCB unrouted, optical and hardware tests pending
label_indicators.assembly_clearance_status: Nominal bodies fit; original courtyard margins overlap and general manufacturer +/-0.25mm tolerances are not qualified.
label_indicators.window_requirements: 1.85mm square copper keepout rotated45deg on all4layers; top mask1.8x1.4mm rotated with LED; bottom lettering horizontal, optical sample required.
label_indicators.SIG_display: native MCU icon, 3 pins per side,0.14mm stroke

free_esp_gpio_addition.correction: Free pad23 is GPIO21, not GPIO14; GPIO14/pad22 is USB_VBUS_PRESENT. GPIO21 and GPIO13 now used by UI.

label_silkscreen.style: 16 horizontal rounded capsules around the three illuminated words, short dividers and leaders to row labels

ui_buttons.logic: active low; internal pullups; debounce and simultaneous hold in firmware; boot safety reset unchanged

ui_indicators.short_indicator_reason: SY6280A has no FAULT/status output or current measurement
ui_indicators.pin_mode_scope: global indicators for currently selected row, only when MCU-connected
ui_indicators.pull_controls: internal MCU pulls, no new pull resistors
